beats.care: If you moved to Bengaluru or just turned 18, check your name now. Forms are on the ECI and GBA websites.
beats.what: The Greater Bengaluru Authority is running a special drive to add eligible citizens to the voter list, following Election Commission directions.
beats.why: The draft roll had 56.99 lakh voters. About 2 lakh more are expected, taking Bengaluru to roughly 59 lakh.

cards.body: That's how many new-voter applications Bengaluru Urban district has received, GBA Chief Commissioner M Maheshwar Rao said.
cards.caption: Form 6 applications

cards.q: You moved from Jayanagar to Hebbal. Which form fixes your voter address?
cards.why: Form 8 covers address changes and corrections. Form 6 is for new voters, and Form 7 is for objections or deletions.

cards.body: Party booth agents can file at most 10 Form 7 deletion requests each. Bulk filings are restricted so genuine voters aren't removed by mistake.
cards.title: Mass deletions blocked

cards.body: The Election Commission told booth officers to verify voters by visiting homes, not by calling them to hearings.

cards.q: Have you checked your voter listing?

hook: New in Bengaluru? Your voter-list deadline is *October 22*

learn.t: Form 6 is for new voters. Form 8 handles address changes, corrections and replacement voter ID cards.

sources.name: Deccan Herald
sources.title: Karnataka SIR | GBA to hold special drive for voter enrolment

tldr: The GBA is running a special drive to add new voters, and claims and objections close on October 22.
watch: Claims and objections close October 22. The final voter roll comes out October 27.
